traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Juncaginaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; veins parallel; blades linear; stipules present or absent; leaf rosettes basal; plants dioecious or polygamous; ovary superior; stems herbaceous; flowers in racemes or in spikes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals or absent; fruit follicle, achene or schizocarp; stamens 3 to 8; carpels 1 to 6. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
